events.title: Beyond the Plastic Wall at Steam Next Fest and more!
events.summary: Hi everyone,As you might know, Steam Next Fest is running from October 19th to 26th.And Hal didn’t do the journey empty-handed:Demo with new languages: Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese And new, more fluid animations Try it all out for yourself during this October Next Fest!But that’s not all!Beyond the Plastic Wall satisfying puzzles await you at Paris Games Week, from October 22nd to 25th Come share a part of Hal’s journey, beyond the plastic wall at the ARTE booth!

events.title: Playtest applications for Beyond the Plastic Wall are now open!
events.summary: Hello everyone! As Beyond the Plastic Wall reaches a new stage of development, we're excited to announce our very first playtest! Applications are open from now until July 9th at 11:59pm. To participate, you'll need to complete an application form and agree to a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA). This means that you won't be allowed to share or publicly discuss any part of the game before its official release. If you're selected, you'll receive a Steam key to access the playtest. events.title: Explore the First Steps of Hal's Journey – Demo Available Now
events.summary: After the warm reception Beyond the Plastic Wall received at A MAZE,we thought the best way to thank you for your support was to share the demo with everyone.(And nooo, you definitely didn't see this demo accidentally shown up before, right? 👀)Whether you missed A MAZE 2026 or simply want to experience it again, now's your chance.Feel free to share your feedback with us so we can make the game even better!Until we meet again, travellers.
